spec.expr: (sum by (queue)(label_replace(label_replace(rate(app_jobs_dispatched_total{scrape_job=~"$environment",queue!="sync"}[$__rate_interval]), "queue", "$1", "queue", "(.*)-env-[0-9a-f-]+"), "queue", "$1", "queue", "cloud-shop-api-(.*)")) or (sum by (queue)(label_replace(label_replace(rate(app_jobs_processed_total{scrape_job=~"$environment",queue!="sync"}[$__rate_interval]), "queue", "$1", "queue", "(.*)-env-[0-9a-f-]+"), "queue", "$1", "queue", "cloud-shop-api-(.*)"))) * 0) - ((sum by (queue)(label_replace(label_replace(rate(app_jobs_processed_total{scrape_job=~"$environment",queue!="sync"}[$__rate_interval]), "queue", "$1", "queue", "(.*)-env-[0-9a-f-]+"), "queue", "$1", "queue", "cloud-shop-api-(.*)"))) or (sum by (queue)(label_replace(label_replace(rate(app_jobs_dispatched_total{scrape_job=~"$environment",queue!="sync"}[$__rate_interval]), "queue", "$1", "queue", "(.*)-env-[0-9a-f-]+"), "queue", "$1", "queue", "cloud-shop-api-(.*)"))) * 0)
